acceptance_repairs.given: An actor who is not the current Acceptance lifecycle owner attempts to publish an acceptance-passed result.
acceptance_repairs.when: The Toolchain applies publication authorization to that acceptance-passed publication attempt.
acceptance_repairs.then: The publication attempt is denied because only the current Acceptance lifecycle owner may publish acceptance-passed.

oracle.observable: The terminal publication-authorization decision identifies the attempting actor, the current Acceptance lifecycle owner, and the denied outcome.
oracle.expected: Publication is authorized only when the attempting actor is the current Acceptance lifecycle owner.
forbidden: An actor who is not the current Acceptance lifecycle owner publishes acceptance-passed.
A non-current lifecycle owner is treated as authorized to publish acceptance-passed.
